dedupe_keys.name: tree canopy cover atlas of the helsinki metropolitan area helsinki espoo vantaa

description: The tree canopy cover atlas shows the share of land covered by tree crowns across the Helsinki Metropolitan Area, by municipality, city district and city block. The Zenodo record read on 2026-09-28 explains that canopy cover is a green infrastructure indicator combining climate and well-being benefits, now required to be monitored in urban areas under the EU Nature Restoration Law, that the calculation is based on several spatial datasets, and that the amount of trees varies greatly between districts; the files are PDF maps of canopy cover by municipality, district and block for Helsinki, Espoo and Vantaa, the largest about 49 MB, published on 8 June 2025 under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence. Coverage is Helsinki, Espoo and Vantaa. Access is free download. Caveats: the atlas is distributed as maps, not GIS layers, so values must be read off the maps, and the input data vintages are described only in the record. It supports urban heat and stormwater adaptation planning with green infrastructure in the Helsinki region. Related record: data-helsinki-3d-city-models complements it with building and energy data for the same city.
